objects.original: Real reciprocal cosine spectrum, literal rho=(sqrt(kappa)-1)/(sqrt(kappa)+1), positive cosine modes.
objects.reconstructed: The same real r and series, with explanatory a_j/S/S_N definitions.
objects.evidence: Frozen phase1 plus A3.Thmtheorem7/Ex133; literal public signature and fresh exact anonymous producer type.

domains.original: theta in all real numbers; modes j>=1; inherited kappa>=2.
domains.reconstructed: Real kappa/theta, natural j starting at zero with both exponent and frequency j+1.
domains.evidence: Positive-mode index shift is bijective; Finset.range N contains exactly modes1..N; no constant-mode loss.

quantifiers.original: For each fixed allowed kappa, all theta pointwise equality and absolute convergence; uniform in theta.
quantifiers.reconstructed: kappa precedes all claims; epsilon then N0, valid for every later N and every real theta.
quantifiers.evidence: Uniform threshold may depend on kappa and epsilon, never theta; fresh type defeq and public TendstoUniformly conclusion.

assumptions.original: Standing source kappa>=2 and literal rho; proof ingredients are not caller hypotheses.
assumptions.reconstructed: Only real kappa>=2 is a premise; summability and uniform convergence are conclusions.
assumptions.evidence: Production has no scoped variables or bundles. radius_bounds, denominators, actual HasSum and majorant are internally proved and kernel-backed.

conclusion.original: Exact normalized expansion, absolute convergence, uniform convergence.
conclusion.reconstructed: Same equality and two convergence claims to the specified tsum.
conclusion.evidence: All three public conjuncts retained; fresh exact type check; scalar norm summability prevents totalized-tsum default from substituting for the source sum.

scopes.original: Real all-angle function expansion; complex geometric quantities only proof tools; finite-grid use later.
scopes.reconstructed: Uniform convergence of the unscaled positive-mode series on all real angles, at fixed kappa.
scopes.evidence: Source C7 and complete production proof agree. Separate private all-natural-n finite-grid intermediate does not claim Gaussian/C8 closed forms.

constant_dependencies.original: Numerator2, constant1, modal2, outside1/sqrt(kappa), alternating rho powers; no new free constants.
constant_dependencies.reconstructed: All factors/signs retained, rho fixed by kappa, threshold dependence explicit.
constant_dependencies.evidence: Production pointwise formula and hparam/hnorm; six authored formulas checked; no normalization or dependency delta.
